summary: Possible typosquat of @coral-xyz/anchor / @project-serum/anchor with unverified bundled code
details: Package is published under the `@solana-labs` scope as `ancor` — a name 1 character removed from `anchor`, the well-known Solana smart-contract framework historically published as `@project-serum/anchor` and currently `@coral-xyz/anchor`. The `@solana-labs` scope is associated with Solana's official tooling, which raises brand-impersonation concerns for a package whose name is a misspelling of a major framework in the same ecosystem. The shipped bundles (lib/index.cjs.js and lib/index.esm.js) contain `require('child_process')` together with `fetch(...)` POST calls, `curl`, and `ping` references. Static keyword co-occurrence in a large minified bundle does not by itself establish exfiltration intent — these primitives are also present in legitimate developer tooling — and full semantic tracing of the bundle did not complete in this run. Given the name-collision against a top Solana ecosystem package combined with unverified network + child_process primitives in the shipped code, a human reviewer should confirm whether the bundle's network/exec paths are reachable on import or only via explicit API calls, and whether the publisher is in fact Solana Labs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
